description: Defines the TouchVideoDevice class for interfacing with a v4l2 video device that reports touch heatmap data, including methods for creation, frame reading, and device info retrieval.

classes.name: TouchVideoDevice
classes.description: Represents a v4l2 video device for touch heatmap data, providing creation, frame reading, and device info methods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new TouchVideoDevice instance for the specified device path.

methods.name: hasValidFd
methods.description: Checks if the device has a valid file descriptor.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the device.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the heatmap frame.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the heatmap frame.

methods.name: readAndQueueFrames
methods.description: Reads frames from the device and queues them internally.

methods.name: consumeFrames
methods.description: Returns all queued frames and clears the internal buffer.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the device.

methods.name: readFrames
methods.description: Reads all available frames from the device.

methods.name: readFrame
methods.description: Reads a single frame; may return nullopt if no data is available.
